rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a music album, including digital releases.

example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 zyun1 cap1 jau5 sap6 sau2 go1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on a physical recorded release or record rather than the album as a release.

example.english: I finally bought that band's new album.
example.traditional: 我終於買到嗰隊樂隊嘅新唱片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 maai5 dou2 go2 deoi6 ngok6 deoi6 ge3 san1 coeng3 pin3

rows.note: Use this for the usual book or collection for keeping photographs.

example.english: This album is full of photos from when I was little.
example.traditional: 呢本相簿入面全部都係我細個嗰陣影嘅相。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 soeng2 bou2 jap6 min6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 jing2 ge3 soeng2
